description: Hold the frame at at_frame for duration_frames: the clip splits there, a freeze frame goes in, and later clips on its tracks move later. Freezing a clip's last frame holds it after the clip, with silence under the hold. Returns the new timeline_id (edit that one next), what changed, and where each changed clip now sits.

other_tracks.description: Tracks holding neither this clip nor a clip linked to it (linked clips, such as its own sound, always change with it): what they do when this edit moves later clips. stay: they don't move, and the result warns which clips there now play early or late. sync: they get the same change, so titles, overlays and sound stay in step: time taken out here comes out of them too (like range.extract), time added here opens the same gap in them (clips crossing that point are split, as insert does). Locked tracks always stay

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

name: clip.freeze

changed.description: What the edit added, removed or modified; a clip or transition says its track and where it now sits (frames, end exclusive)

clip_id.description: The clip this edit made or acted on (each tool says which)

clip_ids.description: Every clip this edit made or acted on, linked ones included (each tool says which)

parent.description: The version this edit started from

frames.description: Frames shown; for a waveform, the start and end of its span

loudness.description: Measured for audio edits, over the waveform span

timeline_id.description: The new version: edit this one next (older ids stay valid)
